entities.summary: Løkken Church is a parish church of the Church of Norway in Orkland Municipality in Trøndelag county, Norway. It is located in a rural area between the nearby villages of Bjørnli and Løkken Verk. It is the church for the Løkken parish which is part of the Orkdal prosti (deanery) in the Diocese of Nidaros. The red, wooden church was built in a long church style in 1929 using plans drawn up by the architect Roar Tønseth. The church seats about 170 people.
